name: Camp Three Rivers
street_address: 90 Stow Street (Emerson Field, Hunt Recreation Center)
description_short: A town-run summer day camp in Concord, MA, at Emerson Field, for children entering kindergarten through 8th grade, with a counselor-in-training (CIT) program for grades 9–10. Activities include swimming, art, sports, nature/science, music/drama and archery, plus weekly field trips. Older groups go on more trips each week.
refund_policy_summary: A 50% deposit is due at registration in February and is non-refundable; the other 50% is due May 1. Cancelling before May 1 costs a $35 fee. After May 1, a 50% refund of the final payment (less $35) is possible if June weeks are cancelled by May 8, July weeks by June 1 and August weeks by July 1. Transfers cost $35.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim at the outdoor Emerson Pool, closed to the public during camp and staffed by certified water safety instructors and lifeguards. Free swim only, no lessons. Campers take a swim test to use the deep end.

warnings: The page gives no dates, year or prices. The season year 2026 is worked out from '46th anniversary' since 1980, and that season is now over (today is 2026-10-13). Details for 2027 have not been posted on this page.
No bookable sessions are listed. The four programs (Assabet K-2, Sudbury 3-6, Trekkers 7-8, CIT 9-10) are age groups, not dated sessions. The CIT program runs in blocks of 2 consecutive weeks.
The street address and phone are for the Hunt Recreation Center contact office. This may not be where the camp itself takes place.
Staff are First Aid/CPR certified and the camp is licensed by the Concord Board of Health. ACA accreditation is not mentioned.
